'''William Hiroki Okamura''' (born 1941)<ref name="a">{{Citation|title=Faculities, Publications, and Doctoral Theses in Chemistry and Chemical Engineering at United States Universities|date=1991|publisher=American Chemical Society. Committee on Professional Training|page=126}}</ref> is an American [[chemist]]. He was a [[distinguished professor]] in the department of [[chemistry]] at the [[University of California, Riverside]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://profiles.ucr.edu/app/home/profile/wokamura|title=William H Okamura|work=[[University of California, Riverside]]|access-date=July 27, 2026}}</ref>

In 1998, Okamura was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=okamura&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=July 27, 2026}}</ref>
